content.short: Alien Worlds is a sci-fi crypto game where in-game NFTs represent land, tools, items, weapons, and avatars used to complete missions.
content.description: Alien Worlds is an interstellar metaverse where players undertake missions to earn resources and the project's native token. The experience is powered by NFT functionality, with assets such as land, tools, items, weapons, and avatars represented as NFTs on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Immutable X, and Polygon. The ecosystem features several player-owned Planet DAOs that govern metaverse development and governance, giving communities a direct say in how worlds evolve and how resources are allocated.
